sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: CSV Data Analysis Tool exists to make business intelligence accessible to anyone with a spreadsheet -- no data warehouse, no BI consultant, no weeks-long setup. Upload a CSV and get an instant schema, SQL querying, and interactive charts in seconds.

sections.heading: Our Story
sections.body: We started this project because too many teams have data trapped in CSV exports with no easy way to explore it -- just a spreadsheet and a lot of manual scrolling. We built the tool we wished existed: upload, get intelligence, done.

sections.heading: What We Believe
sections.body: Good data tools shouldn't require a data engineering team to operate. We're committed to keeping the core experience fast, free to start, and genuinely useful from the first upload.

sections.heading: Get in Touch
sections.body: Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature? We'd love to hear from you. Reach us at the email address below and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

sections.heading: Support
sections.body: For account or billing questions, please include the email address associated with your account so we can find you faster.

sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.body: Create a free account, then upload a CSV from your dashboard. We'll parse it, infer a schema, and show you a preview -- usually in a couple of seconds, even for large files.

sections.heading: Uploading a CSV
sections.body: Drag and drop or select a CSV file up to the configured size limit. We automatically detect column types (dates, numbers, categories, free text), normalize common null values, and compute a data-quality health score.

sections.heading: Reviewing Column Types
sections.body: Every column gets a best-guess category. Columns we're unsure about are flagged for review -- you can accept our AI's suggestion, override it yourself, or rename a column's display label at any time.

sections.heading: Running SQL Queries
sections.body: Once a dataset is uploaded, query it directly with SQL. Queries run against the underlying data engine and return results in real time, with no need to export to another tool.

sections.heading: Visual Reports & Dashboards
sections.body: Generate a prioritized set of chart recommendations for any dataset with one click -- time series, histograms, and category breakdowns, each backed by real query results you can filter and drill into.

sections.heading: Exporting & Sharing
sections.body: Download any chart as a JPG or PDF, export a full presentation as a standalone HTML file or PDF, or generate a shareable read-only link anyone can view without an account. Add your own logo and footer branding from Settings.
